video.title: Ja Morant TRADED To Portland | What Is Going On?!

summary: Josh Lloyd breaks down the trade that sends Ja Morant to Portland for Jerami Grant and Kris Murray, with no draft picks changing hands. He says Morant was essentially salary dumped. Morant's fantasy game is weak and he can't stay healthy, so he should not go in the top 50 to 60. Portland now has far too many guards. That hurts the value of Deni Avdija, Damian Lillard, Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson and Jrue Holiday, and he expects more trades (possibly for Jaylen Brown). In Memphis, Grant is not a draftable standard-league target because he only scores. Ty Jerome becomes the likely starting point guard and an attractive pick. Cameron Boozer's outlook is mostly unchanged. The broader lesson is that early mock drafts mean little this early because rosters keep changing, and stats from previous seasons must be scaled back when talent piles up on one team.

rules.text: Mock drafts this early in the offseason are mostly pointless because many moves will still change player values.
rules.quote: I don't do mock drafts at that point, because to me, it's relatively pointless.

rules.text: Avoid giving absolute verdicts on a trade while more moves are clearly still coming.
rules.quote: it's going to be foolish to be giving absolutes here. Because there has to be more happening.

rules.text: When a team adds other high-usage, ball-dominant players, a player's baseline value drops. It only recovers when those teammates are out.
rules.quote: It will pick up when guys are out, but the baseline value won't be there.

rules.text: There is only one ball. You can't add up every player's previous-season numbers on a stacked team. Scale everything back, and that is where you find value or players to fade.
rules.quote: Everything has to be scaled back. And that's why That's where we end up finding value or finding guys to fade

rules.text: You need to look at full rosters and project players before deciding what round someone belongs in.
rules.quote: I need to sit down and look at what the rosters look like. And then I need to go and project all the players out

rules.text: A player who only scores and is weak in steals, blocks and rebounds has too many category holes to be a standard-league target.
rules.quote: there's just too many sort of holes in what he does, plus uncertainty about role

His athleticism has declined. He can't stay healthy, he has off-court problems, and he was suspended by his own team.
